messages.subject: Collapsible Widgets
parts:
I've got an app with a bunch of checkboxGroupInput() widgets in the sidebar. It looks really busy and I'd like to clean it up such that when the app loads:

1. Each checkboxGroupInput' label is visible but the choices are not
2. Clicking on any label causes the choices to appear directly below it
3. Clicking on a label with its choices visible causes them to disappear again
4. Any boxes that have been selected will remain selected even if they've been disappeared by clicking their label

A great example of this functionality can be seen in the sidebar of this page with the "Recently Viewed", "Recent Searches","Recently posted to" widgets.

messages.author: 1117aec6ea33f752
messages.subject: Re: Collapsible Widgets
parts:
take a look at the accordion sidebar from the package bsplus.
make sure to pipe the bs options for desired behavior, for example - the following line of code will case the entire title bar to be clickable, not just the text
# code for creating an accordion sidebar in your ui file/section
bs_accordion("id")%>%

# code for making the entire title clickable
bs_set_opts(use_heading_link = TRUE) %>%

# accordion sidebar with checkbox groups
bs_append(title = "title", content = checkboxGroupInput(...))
